title: Failed demo Try again uses retryOf instead of starting a duplicate same-template build
steps: S1: Run run.cmd in the installed TCH checkout.
S2: Confirm all four cases pass with no failures or skipped tests.
expect: List and Details failed-build controls dispatch retry-demo and POST requestId+retryOf without a template picker or new build selection.
A missing parent action sends no HTTP build request.
An existing latest approved brief2 does not replace the original failed action brief1; the request contains no revisionId and neither input is mutated.
An authority refusal is retained as its server diagnostic, with no fallback new build.

tests: list Try again sends the failed action as retryOf without a template picker or replacing the current brief
details Try again sends the failed action as retryOf without a template picker or replacing the current brief
a retry without its parent action fails without sending a fresh build
a refused retry retains the server diagnostic and never falls back to building approved brief2
